title: A Court of Splintered Harmony Review: The Bat Boys Are in My Bad Books
series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
excerpt: I went into ACOTAR Book 6 excited to return to Prythian and came out questioning half my favourite characters. Between the Crescent City connections, everyone's treatment of Nesta and some very questionable Bat Boy behaviour, A Court of Splintered Harmony annoyed me in all the most interesting ways. My fictional T-shirt order is officially on hold.
author: Sarah J. Maas

title: A Court of Silver Flames Review: Nesta, You Finally Won Me Over
series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
excerpt: After struggling through A Court of Frost and Starlight, I wasn't exactly desperate for another book about Nesta's misery. But A Court of Silver Flames surprised me. Between Cassian, the wonderful new friendships and Nesta's redemption, I went from wanting to abandon it to wishing I'd finished it years earlier.
author: Sarah J. Maas

title: A Court of Frost and Starlight Review: The Book I Couldn't Finish for Two Years
book: A Court of Frost and Starlight
series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
excerpt: I adored the first three ACOTAR books, but A Court of Frost and Starlight was another story. After two years, multiple rereads and an impressive amount of procrastination, I finally finished it in 2026. Was this quieter, post-war novella worth persevering with? Surprisingly, yes. Mostly.
author: Sarah J. Maas

title: A Court of Wings and Ruin Review: The Book That Broke Me
book: A Court of Wings and Ruin
series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
excerpt: The third ACOTAR book brought shocking revelations, unlikely alliances, unforgettable battles and more tears than I was remotely prepared for. From Lucien's journey to the devastating final battle, here's my review of A Court of Wings and Ruin, including a spoiler-filled discussion of the moments that broke me.
author: Sarah J. Maas

title: A Court of Mist and Fury Review: The Book That Made Me Obsessed
book: A Court of Mist and Fury
series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
excerpt: After three attempts to get into ACOTAR, I read the next three books in July 2024. From Rhysand's unexpected return to the shocking twists I never saw coming, here's why A Court of Mist and Fury turned my fantasy reading habit into a full-blown obsession.
author: Sarah J. Maas
